periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Elongated vertical orientation approximately 80 degrees relative to the snout-ear axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval with a vertical height approximately 2.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible tapering at the inferior pole, extending the patch significantly below its geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature on the posterior edge of the scapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 40 percent of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distance between the interior bases of the ears is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the apex of both visible ears.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast visibility of the dark-pigmented plantar surfaces of both hind paws and a dark fur patch in the inguinal region.
